entities.summary: Martin Hattala was a Slovakian pedagogue, Roman Catholic priest, theologian and linguist. He is best known for his reform of the Štúr's Slovak language, so-called Hodža-Hattala reform, in which he introduced the etymological principle to the Slovak language.
